exportar.alDia: It already has every change: only if you want to redo it.
exportar.listoSinVideo: Export the video to mark it ready.
exportar.seExportaSolo: It exports first: you can schedule once the video is ready.
exportar.bajaAlTerminar: It downloads on its own once the export finishes.

escenario.verEnRed: Preview as TikTok, Reels or Shorts

linea.recorrer: Tap or drag to move through the clip

editar.resumen: Lasts {dura} · {cortes, plural, =0 {no cuts} one {# cut} other {# cuts}} · starts at {inicio} of the episode
editar.elegiTramo: Tap a video segment on the timeline
editar.ayuda: Split cuts the video at the playhead. To land it exactly: ← → move it one frame (Shift: one second), space plays and S splits. Tap a segment (or drag) on the timeline and remove it. Striped parts don't play; the ✕ brings them back.
editar.velocidadAyuda: Text, cuts and captions are edited the same; the music isn't sped up.

texto.ayuda: Drag the text on the video to move it. Its edges on the timeline set when it shows.

subtitulos.mostrarAyuda: They come from the episode transcript

superposicion.ayuda: Drag the image on the video to move it; the corner resizes it. Its edges on the timeline set when it shows.
superposicion.ayudaVideos: Drag the video on the preview to move it, or make it full screen. It goes over the video and the images, under the texts and captions.

formato.zoomAyuda: At 100% the box uses the video's full height. Raise it only to get closer.

auto.encontro: Found {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}.
auto.ajustar: Then move the boxes on the video on the left, or in Format.
